data.name: Rage Powers
data.description: The following rage powers complement the feral gnasher archetype: increased damage reduction, scent, superstition (Core Rulebook); beast totem, beast totem (greater), beast totem (lesser) (Advanced Player's Guide); eater of magic, ghost rager (Ultimate Combat).
